name: Lemon Cherry Gelato
summary: **Lemon Cherry Gelato** is a [[kind:cultivar|cultivar]] of unconfirmed breeder origin, a cross of [[sunset-sherbet|Sunset Sherbet]] and [[gsc|GSC]]. It was popularized by the Bay Area brand Backpackboyz, which debuted it at a Cookies dispensary in Los Angeles in late 2019; some sources cite an unidentified third parent.
